# lifesim-r0yc: Plates stay where a meal stopped; lifers clear them later, sooner or later by mood and traits
task · P2 · auto, lane:sim

## Description
## Goal
Eating leaves a real trace: a plate stays where the meal was, and someone has to take it away.

## Context
Owner, 2026-10-22, his words: if I interrupt a scene, it will leave a plate on the table or somewhere else, which someone will need to move. Sometimes characters are lazy and keep those things there; depending on their psychological state they leave plates and remove them much later. Related: lifesim-5ban.1 (stove cooks meals), the eating actions in content/actions/, needs and traits in design/systems/needs.md and personality docs. This is a new rule from the owner: record it as a decision in design/decisions/ (quote him) and as a requirement in the fitting design/systems doc, then build it.

## Done when
See acceptance.

## Touches
design/decisions/, design/systems/ (eating/needs or objects doc), content/actions/, content/objects/, src/Sim.Core action and object code, tests/

## Out of scope
Dishwashers and washing up beyond carrying the plate to the sink; the look of dirty plates beyond a placeholder.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A decision record quotes the owner and a requirement states: an interrupted or finished meal leaves its plate on the surface or floor spot used; a plate is an object that blocks that spot until taken; a lifer can carry a plate to the sink (or bin) as an action.
2. How soon a lifer clears a plate depends on mood and traits (a lazy or low-mood lifer leaves it longer; a neat one clears it soon); the weights are knobs in content with PLACEHOLDER values.
3. Sim tests: interrupting a meal leaves a plate; a neat lifer clears it within a short window; a lazy, low-mood lifer leaves it much longer; a plate on the only table spot makes the next eater pick another spot (or clear it first).
4. just check green.
